questions.intro: * If more than one applies to you, please check all that apply

q1.question: Are you having trouble with daily necessities?

options.q1_2: I don't have a safe place to live

q1.otherPlaceholder: e.g. I can't get clean drinking water, I have no heating in winter

q2.question: Are you having trouble with safety or security in your life?

options.q2_1: I live in a dangerous area
options.q2_2: I am being bullied or harassed
options.q2_3: I am experiencing physical, mental, or sexual violence or harassment
options.q2_4: I work for less than minimum wage, or do unpaid overtime

q2.otherPlaceholder: e.g. My freedom is restricted for religious reasons, I face discrimination as a refugee

q3.question: Are you having trouble with work, money, or education?

options.q3_1: I have no job, or I am about to lose it
options.q3_2: My income is too low to cover basic living costs

q3.otherPlaceholder: e.g. I have a disability and cannot look for work, I keep working to repay debts

q4.question: Are you currently having trouble with your health or mental well-being?

options.q4_1: I feel unwell but cannot go to a hospital for financial or other reasons
options.q4_2: I sometimes feel like I want to die
options.q4_3: Secondhand smoke is causing me distress
options.q4_4: I work in a dangerous environment and worry about getting injured

q4.otherPlaceholder: e.g. I need mental health care but don't know where to turn, I can't get my medication

q5.question: What kind of support would you like?

options.q5_1: I want to learn about government support programs
options.q5_2: I want to connect with people who share the same struggles
options.q5_3: I want to connect with an NPO or support organization
options.q5_4: I want to consult a professional such as a lawyer or doctor
options.q5_5: I am willing to pay for support

q5.otherPlaceholder: e.g. My child needs protection, I am looking for a place to shelter

hearing.title: Consultation form
hearing.subtitle: Tell us about your situation. AI will connect you with the right support.
hearing.whatHint: The more detail you give, the easier it is to find a supporter for you
hearing.whatPlaceholder: e.g. My parents belong to a religious group and refuse to let me see a doctor. I have had a high fever for a week but cannot get medical care.
hearing.whenLabel: Since when have you been struggling?
hearing.whenPlaceholder: e.g. For 3 months, since last spring
hearing.wantLabel: How would you like things to be?
hearing.wantPlaceholder: e.g. I want to receive treatment in a safe place, I want to live on my own terms
hearing.privacyNote: * What you write here is organized and analyzed by AI to find support organizations that fit your situation. It is shared with supporters only to the extent needed to help you.
